title: armored happy ghast harness
description: Make your ghast a armored flying fortress!
body:
**Add a numerous of armored harness!!!**

with different levels:

1.normal harness: made of iron, up to 100 hp

2.diamond harness: up to 200 hp

3.netherite harness: up to 250 hp

![netherite and diamond armored harness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3690d996cc6b48e8c6a0b73f5cc8c4aa3a6783c.jpeg)

**Don't forget to make enough armor plate to fix the armored harness at time!**
